senses.gloss:
ITA-3.10.1.17 kacāntaḥ कचान्तः
Hairline
The boundary marking the growth of hair on the head, especially over the forehead and temple.

ITA-5.62.6 kacchapikā कच्छपिका
Skin lesions resembling A disorder characterized by hard nodular swellings; tortoise tortoise shell shell-like swelling raised in the middle; five or six in number.

ITA-5.41.1.3 kacchapikāpramehapiḍakā कच्छपिका-प्रमेहपिडका
Carbuncle resembling tortoise shell

ITA-5.63.42 kacchapaḥ (kacchapī) कच्छपः (कच्छपी)
Hard palatal protrusion, A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs torus palatinus and symptoms: a swelling resembling a tortoise back or tortoise-shaped swelling; slowly growing swelling; painless; slowly developing.

ITA-5.59.16 pāmā (kacchū) पामा (कच्छू )
Skin disease with white, reddish or blackish-brown erupting lesions
A skin disease characterized by lesions with a whitish discoloration; reddish discoloration; blue-black colour; itching; papules/eruptions; moistening/soddening; pain; minute; especially in the buttocks; hands and elbows.
